slash_h: The character wields their weapon in its initial form in their right hand, taking a light step forward and swiftly swinging the weapon from right to left.
slash_lr: The character takes a step forward with their left foot, wielding their weapon in its initial form, and swings horizontally from the left to the right.
slash_diag: The character performs a light attack with their right hand weapon in its initial form, firmly stepping forward with their right foot and swinging the weapon from the upper right to the lower left.
slash_up: The character wields their weapon in its initial form in their right hand, taking a light step forward and swiftly swinging the weapon from the left side to the upper right.
overhead: The character takes a step forward with their right foot, wielding their weapon in its initial form, and vertically chops from the top down.
thrust: The character performs a light attack with their right hand weapon in its initial form, firmly stepping forward with their left foot and thrusting the weapon forward.
jump_attack: The character wields their weapon in their right hand in the initial form, attacking with a jumping attack. They swing the weapon with a light, powerful, and straightforward manner, swiftly and cleanly. After jumping forward, they strike downward with the weapon from above.
heavy_finisher: The character charges a heavy attack with a weapon in their right hand in the initial form, takes a heavy step forward, raises the weapon to the top of the head, and grips it with both hands to deliver a powerful downward strike.
